title: Add new release repositories
author: Noel215
body:
* Name of the release team: pal_robotics_team

* Release repositories to add:
  * [play_motion2](git@github.com:pal-robotics/play_motion2.git) 
    * [ros/rosdistro Humble source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/36289)
    * [ros/rosdistro Jazzy source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48287)
    * [ros/rosdistro Kilted source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48288)
    * [ros/rosdistro Rolling source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/48289)

    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/pal-gbp/play_motion2-release

comments.author: cottsay
comments.body: This has been deployed. I recommend updating all ROS distributions to use the new release repositories under `ros2-gbp` so that all of the distributions are in the same place, at which time you may decommission the existing release repo.
